title: First 100 Hours: Onboarding Sprint Checklist & Evidence Pocket
content:
Purpose:
Provide a tight, timeboxed onboarding sprint for new hires to reach functional contribution during the first ~100 hours (roughly first 2 weeks). This doc is intentionally prescriptive: prioritized actions, required accesses, micro-OKRs, and an "evidence pocket" (artifacts the new hire should produce) so managers and mentors can calibrate early impact and identify blockers.

Who should use this: people-ops partners, hiring managers, mentors, and new hires. Works for ICs across engineering, product, and platform teams with minor role-specific tweaks.

Sprint principles (quick):
- Timebox: every task is estimated in hours; focus on earliest unblockers.
- Evidence-led: new hire should produce at least 3 small artifacts by hour 100.
- Paired ramp: daily pairing with mentor or peer for first 10 sessions.
- Risk signals: access delays or failure to land first artifact by day 6 triggers escalation.

Access safelist (must be done by hour 8):
- Okta account + MFA enabled
- Laptop provisioning and disk encryption check
- Internal email + calendar + HR benefits portal
- GitHub org invite and repo read access (list repos)
- Dev/test cluster read-only creds; buildkite/slack/devops channels
- Pager/Oncall access (if role requires)
- Required compliance training links (complete by day 5)

First 100 hours plan (example breakdown):
Hours 0-8 (Day 0-1):
- Welcome sync, HR admin, laptop & VPN smoke test, set up dev environment scaffold (estimate 4-8h).
- Assign mentor & pairing schedule; create private "evidence" folder.
- Quick micro-OKR: "Run full local dev build and open PR template".

Hours 8-40 (Days 1-4):
- Access verification checklist: confirm repo read, CI status, docs access.
- Shadow a team standup, join product/infra onboarding sessions.
- First artifact: 'readme-first-edit' - update an internal README with clarifying notes from onboarding (deliverable).
- Pairing sessions: at least 4 x 1hr sessions with mentor.

Hours 40-80 (Days 5-9):
- Small bugfix or feature spike shipped to internal staging (deliverable #2).
- Security, privacy, and compliance short quiz completion.
- Document a short postmortem of an intentional small failure test (learning artifact).

Hours 80-100 (Days 10-14):
- Deliverable #3: PR merged to mainline or merged demo recorded.
- 1:1 with manager to review micro-OKRs, roadmap, career signals.
- Feedback loop: manager and mentor fill early-ramp calibration form (link in linked_artifacts).

Evidence pocket (artifacts new hire should have by hour 100):
- Updated README or onboarding notes (link saved in evidence folder).
- Merged PR or internal demo recording (screencap link).
- A 1-page "first-week retrospective" written by hire with risks and questions.

Manager checklist (quick):
- Confirm access safelist completed within 8 hours or escalate people-ops.
- Assign mentor and schedule daily pairing first week.
- Set micro-OKRs and success criteria for hour 40, 80, 100.
- Book 1:1s and a 2-week sync with hiring manager + manager-of-manager.

Mentor checklist (quick):
- 1h shadow session on day 1; 4x pairing sessions in week 1; async review within 24h of PRs.
- Provide two onboarding tasks with clear acceptance criteria.
- Keep a short 'handoff log' of topics covered and outstanding questions.

Risk escalation triggers (auto alerts):
- Any required access not granted by hour 12 -> people-ops ticket & manager notified.
- No artifact produced by day 6 -> mandatory calibration call with mentor + manager.
- Repeated CI or infra blockers -> involve platform on-call.

Interview and hiring follow-up (for hires from small interview loops):
- Capture missing evidence from interviewing rubric and assign a 2-week remediation coaching plan if score gaps > 1 band in role competency.
- Add interviewers' feedback summary to candidate file and share with new hire as developmental notes (opt-in).

Template snippets (to paste into calendar / slack):
- "Day 0: Welcome + 30m HR, 60m manager sync, 60m mentor shadow, environment setup highlight"
- Slack intro message: short bio + 3 asks (who to ask about infra, product, culture) + 'evidence folder' link.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Map team-specific repo lists (team leads to supply) -> people-ops needs a canonical per-team mapping.
- Validate that internal training quotas are visible in LMS by API (SRE infra ticket created).
- Decide whether to gate the sprint on completion of basic compliance or allow parallel progress.

Notes and provenance:
- Drafted by Aisha Patel with feedback from Diego Morales and Priya Sharma.
- Cross-references: onboarding playbook (confluence link in linked_artifacts), PEOPLE-842 (Jira ticket for automating access flows).
- Intended to be lightweight and iterable; treat as 'minimum viable onboarding sprint' for fast hires and contractors.

Revision history:
- 2025-01-15 initial draft
- 2025-02-03 updated access timings and added evidence pocket checklist

Quick links (copy to candidate email):
- Evidence folder template: <link in confluence page>
summary: Prescriptive 100-hour onboarding sprint with access safelist, micro-OKRs, mentor pairing plan, deliverables, and escalation rules to accelerate new-hire productivity and reduce early blockers.
